heading: Tuesday, May 5, 2026
topLine: OpenAI makes GPT-5.5 Instant the ChatGPT default.

items.headline: OpenAI makes GPT-5.5 Instant the ChatGPT default
items.summary: GPT-5.5 Instant replaced GPT-5.3 Instant as the default model for all ChatGPT users, with shorter answers and personalization from past chats and connected apps. OpenAI reports 52.5% fewer hallucinated claims on high-stakes prompts in internal evaluations.
